name: Incline Push Up
coaching_cue: Hands on the bench, body in one straight line, lower the chest to the edge under control.

name: Knee Push Up
coaching_cue: Knees down, hips forward so the body stays straight from knee to shoulder, elbows tucked.

name: Dumbbell Chest Fly
coaching_cue: Soft bend in the elbows throughout, open wide only as far as the chest allows, no bouncing.

name: Band Chest Press
coaching_cue: Band across the upper back, press forward and slightly together, control the return.

name: Push Up
coaching_cue: Squeeze the glutes so the hips do not sag, elbows at about forty five degrees, full range.

name: Dumbbell Bench Press
coaching_cue: Wrists stacked over the elbows, shoulder blades pinned to the bench, lower to chest level.

name: Incline Dumbbell Press
coaching_cue: Bench at a shallow angle, press up and slightly back, keep the ribs down.

name: Decline Push Up
coaching_cue: Feet raised, body straight, stop the set the moment the hips start to drop.

name: Diamond Push Up
coaching_cue: Hands close under the chest, elbows brush the ribs, lower slowly and press away hard.

name: Barbell Bench Press
coaching_cue: Feet planted, shoulder blades back and down, touch the chest and press without bouncing.

name: Lateral Raise
coaching_cue: Lead with the elbows, stop level with the shoulders, lower slower than you lift.

name: Front Raise
coaching_cue: Ribs down and no swinging, raise to shoulder height only, keep the neck relaxed.

name: Reverse Fly
coaching_cue: Hinge forward with a flat back, open the arms wide, think of squeezing the shoulder blades.

name: Band Pull Apart
coaching_cue: Arms long, pull the band to the chest, keep the shoulders down away from the ears.

name: Dumbbell Shoulder Press
coaching_cue: Brace the middle so the back does not arch, press straight up, finish with the ears clear.

name: Upright Row
coaching_cue: Pull to the lower chest only and stop if the shoulders complain, keep the elbows wide.

name: Dumbbell Shrug
coaching_cue: Lift straight up towards the ears, pause at the top, no rolling of the shoulders.

name: Barbell Overhead Press
coaching_cue: Squeeze the glutes, press the bar past the face then move the head through, ribs stay down.

name: Pike Push Up
coaching_cue: Hips high, lower the crown of the head towards the floor, elbows follow the body line.

name: Push Press
coaching_cue: Short dip from the knees, drive up hard and finish the lockout with the arms, land tall.

name: Wall Handstand Hold
coaching_cue: Walk the feet up only as far as is comfortable, stack the hips over the hands, come down early.

name: Overhead Triceps Extension
coaching_cue: Elbows point forward and stay put, lower behind the head slowly, stop if the shoulders pinch.

name: Triceps Kickback
coaching_cue: Hinge forward, upper arm pinned to the side, straighten the elbow and pause at the top.

name: Bench Dip
coaching_cue: Hands at the bench edge, hips close to it, lower until the elbows reach a right angle.

name: Cable Triceps Pushdown
coaching_cue: Elbows glued to the ribs, push down to full extension, control the weight back up.

name: Chest Dip
coaching_cue: Lean the chest forward slightly, lower to a comfortable depth, never sink into the shoulders.

name: Face Pull
coaching_cue: Pull towards the forehead with the elbows high, finish with the shoulder blades together.

name: Dead Hang
coaching_cue: Full grip, shoulders active rather than fully slack, breathe steadily and drop down under control.

name: Superman Hold
coaching_cue: Lift the chest and thighs a small distance only, look at the floor, keep the neck long.

name: Romanian Deadlift
coaching_cue: Push the hips back with a flat back, bar close to the legs, stop where the hamstrings tighten.

name: Dumbbell Romanian Deadlift
coaching_cue: Same hinge with lighter load, shins vertical, drive the hips forward to stand tall.

name: Single Arm Dumbbell Row
coaching_cue: Flat back, pull the elbow towards the hip, no twisting through the trunk.

name: Inverted Row
coaching_cue: Body in one line from head to heels, pull the chest to the handles, lower slowly.

name: Seated Cable Row
coaching_cue: Sit tall, pull to the navel with the elbows close, let the shoulder blades travel.

name: Lat Pulldown
coaching_cue: Chest up, pull the bar to the collarbone, avoid leaning back to finish the rep.

name: Deadlift
coaching_cue: Bar over the mid foot, flat back, push the floor away and lock out tall without leaning back.

name: Sumo Deadlift
coaching_cue: Wide stance, knees track over the toes, chest up and push through the whole foot.

name: Kettlebell Swing
coaching_cue: Snap the hips forward to float the bell, arms stay relaxed, the back never rounds.

name: Bent Over Row
coaching_cue: Hinge to about forty five degrees, hold that angle, pull to the waist and lower under control.

name: Pull Up
coaching_cue: Start from a hang, pull the elbows down to the ribs, chin clears the bar without craning.

name: Dumbbell Biceps Curl
coaching_cue: Elbows stay by the ribs, no swinging from the hips, lower slower than you lift.

name: Hammer Curl
coaching_cue: Thumbs up throughout, wrists straight, curl without letting the elbows drift forward.

name: Band Biceps Curl
coaching_cue: Stand on the band, keep tension the whole way, resist the band on the way down.

name: Barbell Biceps Curl
coaching_cue: Shoulder width grip, ribs down, curl without rocking and stop short of the shoulders.

name: Bodyweight Squat
coaching_cue: Feet about shoulder width, sit between the hips, knees track over the toes, chest tall.

name: Reverse Lunge
coaching_cue: Step back and lower straight down, front shin upright, push through the front heel to stand.

name: Glute Bridge
coaching_cue: Heels close to the hips, squeeze the glutes to lift, ribs stay down and no arching.

name: Band Hamstring Curl
coaching_cue: Anchor the band low, curl the heel towards the hip, keep the hips still and the pace slow.

name: Standing Calf Raise
coaching_cue: Rise onto the toes to full height, pause briefly, lower slowly for a full stretch.

name: Goblet Squat
coaching_cue: Hold the bell at the chest, elbows inside the knees at the bottom, chest stays proud.

name: Split Squat
coaching_cue: Long stance, drop the back knee straight down, torso upright, drive up through the front foot.

name: Walking Lunge
coaching_cue: Step forward into a tall lunge, knee softly towards the floor, stand fully before the next step.

name: Step Up
coaching_cue: Whole front foot on the box, stand up without pushing off the back leg, lower quietly.

name: Wall Sit
coaching_cue: Back flat on the wall, thighs towards parallel, weight in the heels, breathe rather than hold the breath.

name: Barbell Hip Thrust
coaching_cue: Shoulder blades on the bench, chin tucked, drive the hips to level and squeeze at the top.

name: Back Squat
coaching_cue: Bar settled on the upper back, brace before you descend, knees out and depth you can control.

name: Front Squat
coaching_cue: Elbows high to keep the bar shelf, torso upright, sit straight down and stand without folding.

name: Bulgarian Split Squat
coaching_cue: Rear foot on the bench, most of the weight on the front leg, lower slowly and keep the hips square.

name: Nordic Hamstring Curl
coaching_cue: Anchor the ankles, lower as slowly as you can with the hips straight, catch with the hands.

name: Jump Squat
coaching_cue: Sit back, jump tall, land softly through the whole foot and absorb into the next repetition.

name: Box Jump
coaching_cue: Choose a height you can land on softly, step down rather than jumping down, stop when the legs tire.

name: Dead Bug
coaching_cue: Press the lower back into the floor and keep it there, move the opposite arm and leg slowly.

name: Bird Dog
coaching_cue: Reach the opposite arm and leg long, hips stay level, move as if balancing a glass on the back.

name: Crunch
coaching_cue: Curl the ribs towards the hips a short distance, hands light behind the head, never pull the neck.

name: Plank
coaching_cue: Elbows under the shoulders, squeeze the glutes, one straight line, stop when the hips sag.

name: Side Plank
coaching_cue: Stack the feet and the shoulders, lift the hips high and hold them level, breathe steadily.

name: Russian Twist
coaching_cue: Sit tall with a long spine, rotate from the ribs rather than the arms, keep the movement smooth.

name: Bicycle Crunch
coaching_cue: Slow and deliberate, opposite elbow towards opposite knee, lower back stays on the floor.

name: Pallof Press
coaching_cue: Stand side on to the anchor, press straight out and refuse to let the trunk turn.

name: Lying Leg Raise
coaching_cue: Hands under the hips if needed, lower the legs only as far as the back stays flat.

name: Hollow Hold
coaching_cue: Lower back pressed down, ribs knitted, raise the arms and legs only as low as you can hold.

name: Hanging Knee Raise
coaching_cue: Stop the swing before you start, lift the knees towards the chest, lower with control.

name: Mountain Climber
coaching_cue: Strong plank position, hips stay low, drive the knees quickly without bouncing the hips.

name: Ab Wheel Rollout
coaching_cue: Roll out only as far as the lower back stays flat, come back with the middle rather than the arms.

name: Jumping Jack
coaching_cue: Land softly on the balls of the feet, arms all the way overhead, settle into a steady rhythm.

name: March In Place
coaching_cue: Tall posture, lift the knees to hip height, swing the arms and keep the breathing easy.

name: Shadow Boxing
coaching_cue: Light on the feet, hands up, punch without locking the elbows and keep the shoulders loose.

name: High Knees
coaching_cue: Quick feet, knees to hip height, stay tall and land on the balls of the feet.

name: Skater Jump
coaching_cue: Bound side to side, land on one leg and stick it briefly before pushing back the other way.

name: Jump Rope
coaching_cue: Small jumps just off the floor, turn the rope from the wrists, elbows close to the body.

name: Bear Crawl
coaching_cue: Knees hover just off the floor, hips low and level, move opposite hand and foot together.

name: Squat To Press
coaching_cue: Squat to a depth you own, then drive up and press in one flow, ribs down at the top.

name: Burpee
coaching_cue: Hands down, feet back to a straight plank, chest to the floor if able, stand and jump tall.

name: Treadmill Sprint Interval
coaching_cue: Straddle the belt to start and finish, hold the pace only while form is clean, walk to recover.

name: Rowing Interval
coaching_cue: Drive with the legs first, then the body, then the arms, and reverse that order on the return.

name: Battle Rope Wave
coaching_cue: Athletic stance with soft knees, make the waves from the shoulders, breathe rather than clench.

name: Ball Slam
coaching_cue: Reach tall, slam through the whole body, let the hips hinge and catch the rebound safely.

name: Shuttle Run
coaching_cue: Decelerate before the turn rather than at it, low hips through the change, touch and drive out.

name: Inchworm Walkout
coaching_cue: Hinge to the floor with soft knees, walk the hands to a plank, walk them back and stand tall.

name: Crab Walk
coaching_cue: Hips lifted and held there, fingers pointing back, move opposite hand and foot without dropping.

name: Kneeling Hip Flexor Stretch
coaching_cue: Back knee under the hip, tuck the tail and squeeze that glute, ease forward only until it pulls.

name: Farmers Carry
coaching_cue: Stand tall with the shoulders back, walk smoothly, set the weights down before the grip fails.

name: Suitcase Carry
coaching_cue: Load one side only and refuse to lean, shoulders level, swap sides for equal time.

name: Medicine Ball Rotational Throw
coaching_cue: Turn from the hips and the back foot, throw hard into the wall, catch and reset before the next.

name: Overhead Carry
coaching_cue: Lock the elbow, ribs down, eyes forward, and lower the bell the moment the arm starts to drift.

name: Sled Push
coaching_cue: Lean into it with a straight line from head to heel, short powerful steps, keep the hips low.

name: Sandbag Clean
coaching_cue: Hinge to grip, drive the hips through and pull the bag close, catch it high on the chest.

name: Kettlebell Clean
coaching_cue: Keep the bell close and guide it around the wrist rather than letting it bang down.

name: Broad Jump
coaching_cue: Swing the arms, jump for distance you can land, absorb quietly through the hips and knees.
